title.zh: 美股盘前要闻一览：特斯拉与SpaceX合并或面临反垄断审查，OpenAI接近完成新融资
title.en: 美股盘前要闻一览：特斯拉与SpaceX合并或面临反垄断审查，OpenAI接近完成新融资

current_state.zh: US premarket roundup highlights a possible Tesla-SpaceX antitrust review, OpenAI's near-completed up-to-$30B raise at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, Calpers trimming Magnificent Seven exposure, SK Hynix canceling Solidigm's IPO plans, and $635M/$110M outflows from US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.
